Commentary.Commentary: So that's it from us, then. Skipper Kane Williamson led from the front today and inspired his side to a victory. The series is now levelled 1-1 and it's all set up to be a cracker as both teams have positives and will look to take the upper hand. The next encounter will take place in Mohali on 23rd October at 1330 IST. Do join us for it. Till then, this is goodbye and take care!

New Zealand skipper and Man of the Match, KANE WILLIAMSON begins by stating that it is nice to talk about a win after a string of losses. Says the wicket was not  an easy one to score quickly. Acknowledges that the bowlers did well to put pressure on India. Adds that they knew they were below par and did not have enough runs to put pressure but they did well despite the dew. Mentions that the two left-arm spinners were brilliant for them which allowed the seamers to be aggressive. Calls it a very good game of cricket and credits India for fighting hard right till the end. (On his ton) Williamson says that he is just happy to contribute as much as he can, does not care if those scores are tons as long as they win. Adds that it was a tough wicket to bat today and is happy they managed to put up a good score. Mentions that the pain in his hands has subsided and is okay now.

India skipper, MS DHONI says it is important especially when you are playing at home (for the crowd to be behind the team). Mentions that they kept losing wickets and that kept hurting them, despite them being in the hunt till the end. Is disappointed that he wasn't able to do more from his end. Adds that he still rues the fact that they kept losing wickets and credits the New Zealand bowlers for bowling well, on a wicket which had uneven bounce. States that there wasn't a lot of dew as the ball wasn't exactly coming on to the bat. Further adds that there will be some game where he will lose the toss and then they will have to play according to the conditions. Applauds his bowlers for doing a fantastic job, especially in the last 20-25 overs as they kept New Zealand under 250.

Hardik Pandya and Umesh Yadav's 49-run stand from 183 for 8 then gave India hope but once again the hosts failed to close the chase out and lost by 6 runs. Every time they had a partnership in the chase, they somehow managed to lose the grip on the game. India will rue the fact it was their game to lose and they had far too many soft dismissals. They will want to address that issue with a lot of youngsters in the team right now.

Chasing 243, India were rocked early when they were 73 for 4 with two of their best ODI players in Rohit Sharma and Virat Kohli back in the hut. MS Dhoni and Kedar Jadhav stitched a 66-run stand to get India back in the game. Once Kedar fell though, India were always losing momentum as they kept losing wickets at regular intervals.

It was Kane Williamson's crafty century in the first innings that helped them post a fighting total on board. The middle order collapsed for them but the bowlers stepped up and put in a superb effort to level the series. Trent Boult finished with figures of 2/25. He along with Tim Southee, who took 3/52 were the destroyers-in-chief.

What a game! Once again we see how low scoring games can be thrilling ones! New Zealand have put in a fine, fine performance here to register their first win on the tour. They have bowled superbly as a team and will be buoyed with their performance tonight.

OUT! BOWLED 'EM! AND THE KIWIS HAVE DONE IT! Bumrah had dismissed Southee in similar fashion earlier and now, Tim has returned the favour. He comes running in and fires in a perfect yorker on middle and off. Bumrah tries his absolute best to dig it out but it's just too good for him. The bails are knocked over and India have been bowled out here. NEW ZEALAND WIN THIS MATCH BY 6 RUNS AND LEVEL THE SERIES 1-1!

Low full toss outside off, Umesh Yadav gets low to this one and hits it straight to the man at mid off. Will only get a single and that will bring Jasprit Bumrah on strike, just what the Black Caps want right now.
Full and on middle and leg, Yadav flicks this through the mid-wicket region. The fielder out in the deep does well to come across and cut it off. Keeps the batsmen down to two. 8 needed off 5 now.
Southee to bowl the final over. 10 needed in 6 balls. Umesh Yadav on strike!
Full toss outside off, Umesh Yadav plays this towards point and manages to steal a quick single. All happening here, folks!
Jasprit Bumrah is the last man in.

OUT! THAT'S A BIG WICKET FOR NZ! And that too at such a crucial point. Is this where the Kiwis can clinch it? The entire stadium is silenced. Boult bangs it in short and outside off, Pandya makes room and slaps it over the cover region. He doesn't get a hold ot it though and it's high in the air. Santner settles himself under it and takes a really good catch. 11 still needed off 7 balls.
Boult fires this in full and on the stumps, Hardik gets an inside edge onto his pads as he tries to dig it out.
FOUR! He clears the infield and gets the results. Length ball angling in on the stumps, Pandya makes room, clears his front leg and lofts it over mid off to pick up a boundary. 11 needed off 9 now.
Slower one from Trent Boult. Pitches it up there and well outside off, Pandya lets it be thinking it will be called a wide. He's wrong in thinking so as the umpire is unmoved.
Back of a length delivery well outside off, a lot of width on offer as Yadav cuts this away down towards third man for a single.
Boult to bowl now. India need 16 runs in 12 balls.
Good length ball outside off, it's cut down to third man for a single.

Back of a length delivery outside off, Umesh punches it straight to the short cover fielder. Pandya however is off for the run but is sent back, in time too. Luckily for him the throw misses but he would have made it anyway.
Matt Henry with an excellent yorker on middle and leg, Pandya is up for it though and he does well to squeeze it out towards mid-wicket for a single. 17 needed off 14 now.
Too straight from Matt, it's a length ball on the pads, Yadav clips it behind square on the leg side for a single.

FANTASTIC FROM MARTIN GUPTILL! Length ball outside off, Umesh Yadav cuts this past the diving backward point fielder. Seems the ball is destined for the rope but Southee comes running in from third man and puts in a dive at full stretch to keep it in. Save two runs for his side. Brilliant stuff.

Tight line from Matt Henry, bowls it on a length around off, Hardik Pandya doesn't middle it but manages to get this pull through towards deep mid-wicket. The throw is good so the batsmen will just take one.
Henry back on for his final over.
Length ball tailing in on middle and leg, it's flicked to deep mid-wicket for a single. Hardik Pandya will keep strike. Still need 22 off 18 deliveries.

Length ball around off, Hardik pushes this towards mid off and takes on Kane Williamson there. The Kiwi skipper gets a direct hit at the bowler's end but Hardik was well in. The ball ricochets off the stumps and this allows the Indian batsmen to take another run. Kane looks frustrated with himself.

Saved a certain boundary there! Back of a length on the body, Yadav pulls this hard towards square leg. Ross Taylor is the man there and he does well to go a few paces to his right and stop the ball from going past him. A single is taken however and that brings Hardik Pandya on strike.
Southee takes the pace off this one and bowls it on a length on off, it's a cutter really as Umesh Yadav is too early into the shot. Tried to push it on the off side for one but fails to do so.
WIDE! Length delivery going down leg, wide signalled by the umpire. 26 needed off 22 now.
Length delivery pitched outside off, Hardik whips this through to deep mid-wicket and takes a single.
On a length and outside off, Hardik Pandya whips this through the mid-wicket region and runs hard to come back for the second. Good running once more, excellent cricket from the Indian pair.
Fullish and around off, it's driven towards mid off for a brisk single. That'll be the end of the over. India need 30 off 24 balls.
Short and wide outside off, Hardik Pandya flashes his bat hard at this. Beats the diving backward point fielder and as a result, gets a couple of runs for it.

FOUR LEG BYES! Boult angles in a length delivery on middle and off, it goes off Pandya's thigh pad as he tries to play across the line and from the right of the keeper all the way to the fence. Indian won't care how the runs come as long as they come.
Length delivery pitched outside off, Yadav dabs it towards backward point and scurries to the other end to complete a single. That's some good running between the wickets.
Play and a miss! Back of a length delivery outside off, Yadav looks to cut it down to third man but fails to do so.
Length ball angling in from around the wicket, Pandya makes a little room for himself and smacks it straight to the man at cover. The fielder was a little deep so that allowed him to take the single.
Good length on off, worked through mid-wicket for a single. India need 39 more in 30 balls.
Southee and Kane have a chat.
Dug in short again, Umesh hooks it off his body towards short fine for a single.
FOUR! Fetch that! Shorter in length, Umesh knew it was coming, he picks that one early and pummels it hard through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Shorter on middle, Pandya swats it down to long on for a single.

On a length outside off, Hardik bottom edges his pull towards mid-wicket. Hardik wants the second and Umesh has to dive to get into his cresae. Anderson's shy at the stumps at the non-striker's end is not on target.
On a length on off, Hardik makes room and slaps it towards deep mid off.
Southee back on to bowl now.
Fuller on off, Hardik clips it nicely through mid-wicket for a single. India need 48 runs in 36 balls.
Fuller outside off, Hardik looks to play through the line but is beaten all ends up.
Mid off drops back.
On a length on middle and leg, Pandya gets across and looks to clip but fails to clip it well.
Good length outside off, punched towards covers.
Dug in short outside off, Umesh goes for the pull and controls his top edge and gets off the strike.
Good length on middle, tucked towards mid-wicket. Hardik wants the single but is sent back. Santner from mid on looks to run him out but fails to hit the stumps.

FOUR! Short and wide outside off, Hardik cuts it hard and over point. Bracewell goes to his left from sweeper cover and dives to stop the ball. He returns the throw but it looks like he has touched the ropes. Third umpire is referred and the replays confirm the same. Vital boundary for India, they need 50 runs in 42 balls.
NOT OUT! Back of a length on middle, Umesh tucks it towards square leg for a quick single. There is a direct hit and the appeal is referred upstairs. Replays show Umesh was well in.
Good length outside off, punched off the back foot for a single to covers.
Edged! Back of a length outside off, Hardik looks to cut it hard but gets it of the edge onto his right boot.
Back of a length on off, Hardik tucks it towards square leg for a couple of runs.
Good length on middle, Hardik pushes it towards mid on that is deep. A single not taken and rightly so.
Henry called back on.
Back of a length on middle, Umesh fails to clip it through and is hit on his body.
Back of a length on off, Umesh defends it.
Umesh plays it towards point off his crease but not in the gap.
Good length on the stumps, Umesh plays it back down the wicket.
Fuller on middle, Umesh leans across and defends it back down the wicket.
Good length on off, Hardik clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Boult back on for a bowl this time.
Floated outside off, Yadav comes forward and defends it.
WIDE! Guptill has bowled yet another wide down the leg side.
Umesh Yadav is the new man in. India need 60 runs in 55 balls.

OUT! Mishra throws it away! Guptill's turning out to be more threatening than all New Zealand bowlers combined! Floated outside off, Mishra wants to hit it out of Delhi, but he skies it instead towards short third man. Bracewell (the substitute) takes the catch. A bit of amateur batting from India.
Mishra clips this one towards mid-wicket.
Pandya pushes it towards covers for a single.
This one is driven down to long on for a single.
WIDE! Bowls another wide down the leg side.
Amit Mishra comes out to bat.  The batsmen do not cross for a reason unknown to logic. New Zealand won't mind though.
OUT! The move works! A full toss on middle, Axar looks to go big but fails to connect cleanly and finds Santner at long on. That is a huge wicket. Guptill is delighted and why not.
WIDE! And another one down the leg side. Another wide signaled.
WIDE! Starts with a wide down the leg side.
Trent Boult was called back on for a bowl. Oh wait, hang on, Martin Guptill to bowl now. He is getting rid of the over left of Devcich.
Powerplay three signaled.
FOUR! Good shot, On a length outside off, Pandya comes forward and drives it on the up through wide mid off for a boundary. 65 needed in 60 balls.
Defends this one back down the wicket.
Clipped down to fine leg for a couple of runs to get off the mark.
Hardik Pandya comes out to bat. New Zealand are right on top here.

OUT! Whattay catch from Southee! Full and outside off, Dhoni looks to punch it down but is early into his shot and ends up pushing it back down the wicket. Southee leans to his right and sticks out his right hand and the ball sticks in his hand. That was superbly done and the crowd is silenced. India need 71 more in 63 balls now.
Shorter outside off, Dhoni hits it through covers. Calls for a couple of runs and gets them in time.
Angled into the pads, clipped to square leg for a single.
Floated on off, Dhoni edges his push down the wicket. 74 needed in 66 balls.
Floated on middle, swept to deep fine leg for a single by Axar.
Good stop! Axar plays this one towards mid on but Santner goes to his left and dives to stop the ball.
SIX! That was coming! Floated on off, Axar gets under it and swings it up and over mid-wicket for a maximum. That shot had to come, first boundary after 8 overs.
Dhoni comes down and nudges it to mid-wicket for a quick single.
Floated on off, Dhoni pushes this one into covers. That lobbed up into the vacant area at covers.
On a length outside off, pushed towards covers by Axar. 82 needed in 72 balls. India have pushed the game deep but are they leaving themselves too much to do?
Fuller again outside off, Dhoni drives it to covers where the fielder misfields and allows a single.
Dhoni punches it to covers off his crease.
On a good length outside off, Dhoni chops it towards Ronchi off the bottom edge.
On a good length on middle, clipped through square leg for a single.
Full outside off, Axar comes forward and pushes it to covers.
Tim Southee returns for a spell. He begins round the wicket to Axar.
Too full outside off, Dhoni looks to drive but gets it off the inner half back down to the bowler.
Dhoni drives it hard but straight to the fielder. You can sense a big shot coming!
Floated outside off, Dhoni looks to drive it through covers but fails to put bat to ball.
Fuller on off, Axar clips it through mid on for a single.
WIDE! Flatter down the leg side, Axar looks to sweep but misses.
Dhoni looks to drive it through covers but gets it to mid on off the edge of the bat. A single taken.
Shorter on middle, Dhoni plays it back down the wicket.
Devcich has gone off the field and is getting some medical attention as expected. Bracewell is on for him.
Dhoni pushes this one through covers for a single to keep the strike. India need 87 more in 84 balls.
Bowls this full toss on the pads, Dhoni works it through square leg for a couple of runs.
WIDE! Slanted down the leg side, Dhoni fails to put it away.
Devcich seems to have hurt his calf muscle here. Slight hold up in play. He looks to bowl once but aborts as he cannot complete the run-up. He gets ready to bowl now.
Flatter outside off, Dhoni looks to play the big shot but fails to bat to ball. That just evaded the stumps.
Shorter on off, Axar works it through wide mid on for a single.
Floated outside off, driven down to long off for a single.
Flatter on the pads, Axar clips it to mid-wicket for a single.
Full and loopy on the stumps, it's played back down the track. Dot ball to end the over.
Loopy and full on middle and off, Axar Patel flicks it in the air towards wide long on and takes a run.
Over the wicket to Axar, it's floated around off, the left-hander plays it back in the direction of the bowler.
This time Santner tosses it up and gives it plenty of flight outside off, Dhoni leans forward, opens the face and taps it a bit square on the off side for a single.
Similar ball, same result.
Shorter and flatter around off, it's punched off the back foot towards covers.
Drinks break!

That almost carried. He's got out in similar fashion before as well. Full on the stumps, Axar Patel drives this back on the up. It falls just short of the spinner who gets low to take it. The left-hander survives. That'll be the end of the over. India now need 96 to win off 96 deliveries with 5 wickets in hand.
Dhoni turns this towards backward square and jogs to the other end to complete a single.
This time it's Axar Patel who drives it back down the ground. It's to long on though this time. A single is taken.
Full ball on the stumps, it's driven down to long off for a single.
Dhoni dances down the track and does well to block the ball.
Full on middle and off, almost a seam-up ball really, Patel takes it on the full and sweeps it through the gap in the leg side for a single.
DEVCICH comes back on.
Tossed up on middle and leg, the southpaw easily pushes this down to long on for one run to end the over.
Floated up on the stumps, driven back down the track.
Played to the mid wicket region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Looped up and drifting in once more on middle and leg, Dhoni walks out to this one and gets it off the pads in an attempt to flick it away.
Short and flat on off, punched back to Santner.
Drifting in and full on middle and leg, Dhoni with a solid front foot defense.
SANTNER is brought back on to roll his arm.
Williamson is back on and has a chat with Ross Taylor about the field.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Patel punches it to the right of Guptill at point. He dives and fires a throw at the bowler's end. Good work as the batsmen decide against taking the single.
Length ball angled across, Axar Patel stands his ground and punches it in front of covers for nothing.
On middle and leg, it's worked through backward square leg for a run.
Full on off, it goes off the inside edge of Axar's bat to the leg side as a single is taken.
Henry with a full ball attacking the stumps, Axar Patel drives this straight back to the bowler.
Axar Patel comes in to bat. Above Hardik Pandya, interesting move that.

OUT! MATT HENRY WITH THE BREAKTHROUGH! He was brought back on for this very purpose and he has delivered for his side. He fires it full and outside off, takes the pace off this one as Kedar Jadhav is into the shot too early. He crouches low to run it down to third man but ends up lobbing it behind to Ronchi who takes a good catch diving to his right. Partnership of 66 has come to an end.
Another conference between Tim Southee, Ross Taylor and Kane Williamson. Williamson is off the field.
Flat and drifting in on middle and leg, Jadhav goes back and works it through the mid-wicket region for a run.
Floats this one up on the stumps, it's pushed down to long on rather easily for a single.
Too straight and too full from Devcich, flicked to mid-wicket for one.
Some good drift for Anton, on middle and leg, it's clipped through the square leg region for one run.
Loopy but pitched on a length this time, Kedhar Jadhav backs away a bit and runs it towards short third man. Takes the man on there and some hard running enables Dhoni to make it in quite easily.
Loopy and full on off, drifting in to the batsman, Jadhav gets an inside edge onto his pads as he tries to drive it through the covers.
Devcich back on for a bowl.
Pitches it just back of a length and on off stump, Dhoni hops a bit and punches it in front of covers.
Another short one pounded in by Matt, MS Dhoni doesn't have anything to do with that.

FOUR! THAT'S DHONI AT HIS BEST! Banged in short once more, Dhoni gets on top of the bounce and pulls it away through backward square leg for a boundary. He didn't actually hit that too hard. It was all about the timing.
Back of a length delivery well outside off, width on offer as Kedar Jadhav steers it past backward point with an angled bat to pick up a single.
Matt Henry bangs this one in short and outside off, Kedar looks to ramp it over the vacant slip cordon but fails to make any connection.
Length ball outside off, run down to third man for a couple.
Matt Henry is back into the bowling attack.
Back of a length ball angling in, blocked off the back foot to end the over.
Pitched just back of a length, outside off, from around the wicket, it's tapped away on the off side off the back foot.
On a good length outside off, Kedar Jadhav guides it down to third man for a single.

Beautiful running between the wickets. Trent angles across a length delivery, Kedhar half-pulls it through mid-wicket and both batsmen run hard for the first one. It allows them to come back for the second rather easily. Great stuff.

Boult has a change of angle, comes from over the wicket and bowls a back of a length delivery which is going down leg, Jadhav gets a glove behind as he attempts to pull but it doesn't carry to the keeper.

Trent Boult angles in a length ball from around the wicket, Dhoni waits for it and cuts this late through backward point. The man from third man comes across to cut it off as the batsmen take a single.
A mini-conference happening. Williamson, Southee, Boult, Santner talking about how to go on here.
50-run stand up between MS Dhoni and Kedar Jadhav!
FOUR! Poor from Mitchell. It's short, flat and too straight. Jadhav gets low to this one and paddle-pulls it past short fine leg to pick up a boundary.
Loopy and turning away around off, Dhoni drives it through the gap in the covers for a run.
Tossed up on off, it's pushed to straight to short cover.
Santner fires in a yorker on the stumps, it's played square on the off side for a run.

SIX! THAT'S BIG! Santner tosses it up on the stumps, Jadhav is on to this in a flash. Plays with the turn, goes inside out and smokes it high and handsome over the cover boundary for half a dozen. That's done beautifully.
Slightly flatter trajectory, on middle and leg, Dhoni steps out and works it through mid-wicket for an easy single.

Swing and a miss! Back of a length delivery outside off, Kedar Jadhav off his back foot looks to pull this hard over mid-wicket. Misses though as the ball goes under his bat and into the keeper's gloves.
Full and outside off, gently pushed towards the cover region for one.
Boult gets this length delivery to angle in on middle and off, MS stays back and taps it down into the track ahead.
Slightly wider outside off, on a bit of a fuller length, left alone by the Indian skipper.
Superb from Guptill. A length ball angling in from outside off, Dhoni cuts it towards point. Is unable to beat a diving Martin Guptill, though.
Comes from around the wicket and angles in a length ball from around off, Kedar Jadhav walks across and tucks it down towards fine leg for a single.
Trent Boult is back into the attack.
Looped up on middle and leg, pushed to mid on. Another good over for India. 11 runs came off it.
FOUR! THAT'S CUT AWAY! Short and wide outside off, Dhoni stays back and cuts it hard through point to send it all the way. Beats the diving fielder out in the deep, giving him no chance.
Santner floats it up around off, Jadhav comes out and eases it down to long off for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

SIX! Oh, Kedar, that's big!! Short and flat around off, Kedar Jadhav waits for it and deposits it high and mighty over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie. He rocked back quickly and gave it the full swing of the bat. Hit it with real power.
Floated on the stumps, blocked off the front foot.
Mitchell Santner is back on.
Good length outside off, Dhoni punches it towards covers.
Punched off the back foot by Dhoni.
This time Kedar works it down to third man for a run.
Dug in short again outside off, Kedar looks to upper cut it at first but then spots the bounce is too much and lets it go through.
Bouncer! Short ball on middle, Kedar ducks underneath it. The umpire signals it one for the over.
A touch short outside off, Dhoni punches it through covers for a single.
Too full on middle, Dhoni turns it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Dhoni drives it through mid off for a single.
Flatter on the pads, Jadhav tickles it towards short fine leg and takes a quick single.
Landed outside off, Jadhav drives it to covers.
FOUR! In the gap! Flatter around off, Kedar kneels down and sweeps it past short fine leg for a boundary. That was neatly done.
On a length outside off, a mistimed drive towards mid on results. No runs taken.
Good length outside off, guided past short third man for  a run.
Outside off, Dhoni guides it down to third man for a single.
Good length outside off, keeps a touch low, Dhoni again mistimes his punch towards square leg off the inside half of the bat.
Dhoni mistimes his punch back down the wicket to the bowler.
FOUR! Short on middle and leg, Dhoni picks it up and pulls it hard through square leg for a boundary.
Henry back on for a bowl.
Dhoni drives it through mid off for a single.

Floated on middle, Dhoni comes down the wicket and looks to work it through mid-wicket but is hit on his pads. An appeal from the bowler but Dhoni was way down the track for the umpire to even consider that appeal.
Shorter on middle, tucked to square leg for a run.
Kedar sweeps this one down to fine leg from outside leg. A couple of runs taken.
Dhoni punches it through covers for a run.
Shorter outside off, Dhoni drives it to covers where Guptill dives to stop the ball.
Shorter length outside off, Jadhav cuts it towards point off his crease.
Another length ball on the stumps, played back down.
Good length outside off, left alone by Jadhav.
On a length outside off, Kedar plays it back down the wicket.
Shorter outside off, Dhoni top edges his pull over mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller on middle, Kedar clips it to square leg for a single.
Fuller outside off, Dhoni drives it hard to covers.
Pushes this one to covers off his crease.
On the stumps, Jadhav gets off the mark with a sweep past short fine leg.
Flatter on middle, Jadhav plays it back down the wicket.
Kedar Jadhav walks in to bat.

OUT! RUN OUT! Trouble for India! Slants this one middle and leg, Pandey clips it towards square leg. The throw comes in from Santner in the deep as Pandey dives to get into the crease for the second run. The third umpire is referred. Replays show that the throw from Santner was on stumps and Pandey has to depart. That's another chance wasted by Pandey to impress on the international level. India in trouble at 73/4!
A run out decision against Manish Pandey is referred upstairs.
Fuller outside off, driven to covers.
Bouncer! Another short ball from Southee. Dhoni sits underneath it and lets it go through.
Shorter outside off, Dhoni lets it go through.
MS Dhoni is the new man in.
DRINKS BREAK!

OUT! Clean catch? That could be controversial. Shorter in length on middle, Rahane looks to pull it through but does not keep it down. The ball flies down to deep backward square leg. Corey Anderson comes in from the deep dives and takes the catch but gets up and says that he is not sure if it carried to the fielder. Third umpire is referred and the soft signal is out. Replays shows that the ball seems to have bounced into the hands of Anderson. The third umpire Shamshuddin takes his own sweet time to conclude that he does not have enough evidence to give it not out. Big wicket for New Zealand!
Third umpire referred for a catch appeal of Rahane. The soft signal is out though.
Fuller on middle, Pandey looks to play the big one but adjusts well to turn it through mid-wicket for a single.
Slower and fuller one on middle, Rahane clips it to deep square leg for a single.
Pandey dabs it down to third man for a single.
Rahane comes forward and defends it back. Just a single from that over. This is a good period of play for the Kiwis.
Floated on middle, Rahane looks to work it through mid-wicket but gets a leading edge towards covers.
Rahane this time walks down and pushes it to mid off. The wait is to see if the ball is past a diving Guptill but it is not and hence no run taken.
Floated on off, Rahane comes forward and clips it towards mid-wicket.
Pandey slices this one to the right of cover-point for a quick single.
Floated on middle, Pandey charges down the wicket and can only pat it back.
Pandey punches this one through cover-point for a single to keep the strike.
Length outside off, punched towards mid on.
On a length on off, Pandey plays it back to the bowler who mimes the throw. The crowd is not happy.
Too full on middle, worked through mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! INTENT FROM RAHANE! Fuller outside off, Rahane takes a step down and whips it, like a tennis forehand shot down the ground over the head of the bowler for a boundary. Not a shot that you would see from Rahane but well executed.
Begins with a length ball outside off, Rahane pushes it to covers.
Tim Southee returns for a spell.
Floated on off, Pandey comes forward and pushes it to covers off the crease.
Quicker one on middle, worked to short fine leg for a quick single.
Full outside off, Pandey opens the face of the bat at the last moment and gets it to  sweeper cover for a single.
Fuller outside off, driven through extra cover for a single.
Loops this one on middle and leg, Pandey slinks down the wicket but ends up yorking himself yet does well to get it down to long on for a single.
Drops it short on off, Rahane punches it down to long on for a single.
Rahane goes back and cuts this flatter ball towards sweeper cover for an easy single. That will be the end of the over.
The batsman has driven it through mid off. They pick up a single.
SIX! THAT'S PUT AWAY WITH DISDAIN! Short and flat on off, Manish Pandey picks up the length early. He rocks back and pulls it hard over the mid-wicket boundary for a flat maximum.
Devcich bowls this slower through the air, Manish Pandey works this towards mid-wicket.

IN THE AIR... BUT SAFE! Rahane skips down the track to this and take it on the full. But he misjudges the flight at the last second and ends up lofting it towards long on. It falls just short of Trent Boult who was fully committed in taking that. He did well to adjust and stop the ball from going past him to the boundary line. Keeps the batsmen to just a single.
Drifting in heavily from outside off, the arm ball it seems, carefully kept out on the leg side.
Drifting in on middle and off, some decent flight on that given by Santner, it's dropped on the on side with soft hands and a quick single is taken.
Ajinkya Rahane has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Santner loops it up on middle and off, Manish just eases this down to long off for a single.
Manish Pandey reaches out to this full ball outside off and pushes it to the cover region.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Floats it up well around off, Pandey leans forward and defends.
Pandey drives this full ball down to long on for one to end the over.
Leg bye! Angling down leg, goes off the pads as Ajinkya looks to flick it away. A leg bye is taken as the ball rolls down the leg side.
Fullish on the pads, it's flicked to deep mid-wicket for one run.
Flatter one on the stumps, some more drift inwards for Devcich, Manish Pandey goes back and pushes it back down the track. That came off the leading edge.
On a fullish length and drifting in on middle and leg, it's clipped to the on side for a brisk single.
Tossed up wide outside off, Pandey reaches out to it and drives it to deep cover for one.
Pandey turns this towards backward square leg for a single to end the over.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Manish Pandey is the new man in.

OUT! A wicket against the run of play. And that too in such an unexpected manner. It's sliding down leg, Kohli still goes after it and looks to flick it away. Ends up getting an edge as Ronchi takes a good catch by shuffling across. Loud appeal for a caught behind. The umpire doesn't move initially but Kohli starts walking. And seeing this, the umpire raises his finger. That's a big wicket for Santner and the Kiwis. They've got the big fish.
On the stumps, blocked solidly.
Shorter on middle and off, Rahane whips this through to deep mid-wicket for one run.

Lovely piece of fielding from the Kiwi skipper! Santner starts off with short and flat delivery on off, Rahane rocks back and pulls it hard towards mid-wicket. Williamson is the man there and he dives low to his right and that too very quickly. Stops a certain boundary. Great effort.
Mitchell Santner introduced into the attack so spin from both ends now.
Short and flat, coming in on the stump, VK punches it to the right of the bowler.
Driven towards the mid on region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Full and attacking the stumps, Kohli eases this down to long on for a single.
Drifting in on middle and leg, it's worked through mid-wicket for a run.
Drifting in from around off, Rahane gets right behind the line and plays it back in the direction of the bowler.
Wide! It's going down leg, wide signalled by the umpire.
Tossed up on the stumps, it's worked to mid-wicket.
Anton Devchich comes on to bowl.
Powerplay 2 has been signaled.
FOUR! SHOT! Good length delivery outside off, Kohli opens the face of the bat and crunches it through the gap in the covers. Lovely timing on that as nobody moved to even try and chase it.
Length ball outside off, punched to covers.

Tailing in from a length on off, Kohli tucks it to short fine leg and says no. Rahane however is still running and is halfway down the track. A decent throw and Rahane would have been gone as he was miles out. Lucky to survive that.
On the shorter side once more, tighter line from Matt Henry this time, Virat Kohli stays back and blocks it into the track ahead.
Slightly back of a length once more, well outside off, no trouble for Ajinkya Rahane to guide it down to the third man fielder and take a single.
Back of a length delivery angling in sharply from outside off, Kohli backs away a bit and steers it past backward point to pick up a comfortable single.
Change of ends for Matt Henry.
Rahane gets right behind the line by shuffling across and taps it to the right of the bowler.
FOUR! DEFT FROM RAHANE! Waits and waits for this slowish length ball outside off, opens the face of the bat and runs it across the third man fence for a boundary. Lovely batting.
Full on middle and off, Virat walks across and clips it down towards fine leg for a single.
The batsman opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. One run added to the total.
On a good length from Southee as he pitches this one outside off, Virat Kohli opens the face of the bat and runs it down to third man for one run.
Slightly fullish in length and there's a hint of away shape, Kohli gets right behind the line and keeps it out confidently.
Shortish delivery coming in to the body, it's turned round the corner on the leg side. Dot ball to end the over.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Fullish and coming in from outside off, Ajinkya looks to drive it through the off side but ends up mistiming it back to the bowler.
Good length delivery outside off, Rahane gets right behind the line and blocks.
Angling in on middle and leg, Kohli tucks this through backward square leg and is off the mark with a single.
Virat Kohli is the new man in and he gets a loud cheer.

OUT! BOULT STRIKES! He's got his just rewards here. Two consecutive maidens and a wicket off the first ball. He comes steaming in and bowls a back of a length delivery outside off, Rohit Sharma looks to punch this away off his back foot but ends up getting an edge. Ronchi behind the stumps takes a regulation catch and that's the end of the Indian Hitman. But wait, there's something wrong here. As Ronchi takes the catch, Rahane immediately runs to Sharma. And it seems like he has dislocated his shoulder. In fact, the moment he played that shot he quickly caught his left shoulder. Has he dislocated it? Not sure, but it seems like he has. He's walking back now, hope he's alright.
On a good length on middle and leg, Sharma makes good use of the wrists and flicks it through mid-wicket for a single to end the over.
Slower one from Southee as he takes a little pace off it, gets it to angle in on middle and leg, worked softly to the right of the bowler.
Fullish and aimed at the base of off stump, Rohit Sharma leans forward, brings his bat down and solidly keeps it out.
Tight line from Tim, pitches it on a length and keeps it just around the off stump, Rohit stands tall and punches it back down the track.
Straying on the pads, it's clipped through backward square leg for a couple.
Southee pitches this just back of a length and outside off, shaping away, it's kept out off the back foot to the off side.
Tim Southee to bowl now. No slips in place for him though.
Back of a length delivery outside off, it's kept out off the back foot to end the over. Consecutive maidens from Trent Boult. Brilliant stuff.
Pitched just ahead of a length and keeps it around the off stump, blocked out off the front foot and into the track.
That's sharp from Trent Boult. Brings out the short one and bangs it in hard. Ajinkya Rahane just about manages to duck and evade it.
On a good length and outside off, Rahane steers this towards Martin Guptill at backward point.
Length ball well outside off, it's left alone by Ajinkya Rahane for the keeper to collect.
Back of a length delivery angling in from outside off, Rahane stays back and punches it in front of covers.
Boult to bowl round the wicket.
FOUR! Good timing! A touch short outside off, Rohit stands tall and punches it wide of covers. The ball races away to the fence. That was beautifully timed!
Bowls a cutter outside off, the ball comes in, Rohit plays it towards mid-wicket.
On a length on off and middle, Rohit presses forward and defends it.
SIX! SWEET! Fuller in length outside off, Rohit stands his crease and just lofts it down the ground over the head of the bowler for a maximum. Superb shot, Rohit! That has woken up the crowd too.
On a length on off, Rohit defends it back down the wicket.
Edged! Shorter outside off, Rahane looks to cut but fails to connect well. The ball takes the inside edge past the stumps for a single.
New Zealand have started off well here with the ball. Can they get an early breakthrough?
Goes back to over the wicket, Rohit plays it through mid off but not for any runs. First maiden of the game!
Rohit closes the face of the bat and plays this one towards mid-wicket.
Angled on a length outside off, Rohit defends it with an inside edge onto his pads.
Good length outside off, Rohit defends it towards covers.
Fuller this time, Rohit presses forward and opens the face of the bat towards point.
On a length outside off, Rohit dabs it towards short third man. They look for a single but then decide against it.
EDGED! A tad fuller outside off, Rohit looks to cut it from his crease but gets a bottom edge past his stumps for a single.
A touch short outside off, Rohit punches it towards covers off his crease.
Back of a length outside off, Rohit guides it towards the gully region.
On a length outside off, Rohit times his punch sweetly towards covers but not in the gap.
Fuller on off, Rohit defends it towards covers.
Good length outside off, punched off the back foot by Rohit towards covers.
Full again outside off, Rahane presses forward and defends it.
This one is guided towards point from Rahane.

FOUR! SWEET! Fuller in length on middle, Rahane gets forward and just presents the full face of the bat to time it down the ground for a boundary. Corey gives chase from mid on but cannot stop the ball.
Fuller on middle, Rahane clips it towards mid-wicket but not in the gap.
On a length on middle, Rahane is right forward to defend that one.
Fuller and angling into Rahane, who clips it towards mid-wicket off his crease.
Trent Boult to bowl with the second new ball from the other end.
Similar length, Rahane works it behind square on the leg side for a single. He too is off the mark.
On a length on off, Rahane stands tall and defends it.
Fuller outside off, Rahane covers the line and defends it back to the bowler.
On a length again outside off, Rohit places it wide of the point fielder for a single to get off the mark.
On a similar length, Rohit comes forward and defends it.
Starts off with a good length delivery on off, Rohit turns it towards mid-wicket.

Welcome back for the chase! The players are out in the middle. India don't have a huge score but will want to begin it well and ensure there not many hiccups. The two openers are out in the middle for India, in Ajinkya Rahane and Rohit Sharma. New Zealand begin with Matt Henry.
